reference_document: FS-M-19-1492-A (P-38G 42-12690, 22 Oct 1942): Type D-2 Kollsman pitot-static head 87 in inboard of the left wing tip, static holes 28 in aft of the leading edge and 14-1/4 in below the lower surface. Flaps-up pairs are the report's water-column (instrument-error-free) airspeed against calibrated airspeed, 95-115 mph IAS. Flaps-down pairs are the stall IAS less the +2 mph instrument error the flaps-up rows show. Above the measured band the installation error is ASSUMED to taper linearly to zero at 200 mph IAS (174 kt); flaps-down points above 66 kt IAS are likewise assumed.
